ui_usage_local: kuri mudasobwa, nta kiguzi cya API
ui_usage_cost_note: Igiciro ni igereranya: icyo tokens izi zatwara binyuze kuri API y'utanga serivisi ku biciro bisanzwe. Si cyo wishyura; abiyandikishije ntibishyuzwa kuri buri busabe.
ui_idle_hint: Kanda ku gishushanyo cy'umugereka kugira ngo ukore incamake y'iyi paji.
ui_truncated: Iyi paji yari ndende; igice cya mbere ni cyo cyonyine cyakorewe incamake.
error_page_unreadable: Iyi paji ntishobora gusomwa. Paji za mushakisha na Chrome Web Store ntibishyigikiwe.
error_no_content: Nta nyandiko y'inkuru yabonetse kuri iyi paji.
error_needs_click: Kanda ku gishushanyo cy'umugereka kugira ngo ukore incamake y'iyi paji. Iyo tabu imaze kujya ku yindi paji, umugereka ukenera ko wongera gukanda kugira ngo uyisome.
error_host_missing: Igice cyo kuri mudasobwa ntikiyinjijwemo cyangwa ntigisubiza. Mu bubiko bw'umugereka, tangiza: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: Claude Code ntiyabonetse. Yinjizemo, hanyuma wongere utangize ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_auth: Ntabwo winjiye muri Claude Code. Tangiza claude muri terminal hanyuma winjire.
error_codex_signed_out: Ntabwo winjiye muri Codex. Tangiza codex login muri terminal.
error_codex_not_eligible: Gahunda yawe ya ChatGPT ntishobora gukoreshwa kuri ibi. Hitamo undi utanga serivisi.
error_usage_limit: Wageze ku mbibi z'ikoreshwa rya gahunda yawe. Ongera ugerageze nyuma cyangwa uhitemo undi utanga serivisi.
error_provider_failed: Utanga serivisi yananiwe igihe yandikaga incamake. Ongera ugerageze.
error_codex_missing: Codex ntiyabonetse. Yinjizemo, hanyuma wongere utangize ./native-host/install.sh
options_help: Incamake zinyura mu gice cyo kuri iyi mudasobwa: gitangiza Claude Code cyangwa Codex ukoresheje ifatabuguzi ryawe, cyangwa moderi muri Ollama. Inyandiko ya paji yoherezwa gusa ku utanga serivisi wahisemo.
error_ollama_missing: Ollama ntikora kuri iyi mudasobwa. Yinjize uyikuye kuri ollama.com hanyuma uyifungure, maze wongere ugerageze.
error_ollama_model_missing: Iyi moderi ntiyakuwe muri Ollama. Tangiza ollama pull n'izina rya moderi (urugero, ollama pull llama3.2), maze wongere ugerageze.
options_models_checked: Urutonde rwa moderi rwasomwe ku wa {date}.
options_models_auto: Ruturuka muri Claude Code, Codex na Ollama, kandi rwongera gusomwa rimwe ku munsi, iyo Claude Code cyangwa Codex bivuguruwe, n'iyo umugereka uvuguruwe.
error_file_access: Kugira ngo ukore incamake y'amadosiye ari kuri iyi mudasobwa, fungura Ibisobanuro by'umugereka muri chrome://extensions maze ufungure Emerera kugera kuri URL z'amadosiye.
error_pdf_unreadable: Iyi PDF ntishobora gufungurwa. Ishobora kuba irinzwe n'ijambobanga cyangwa yangiritse.
error_pdf_no_text: Iyi PDF nta nyandiko ifite yo gukorerwa incamake. Ishobora kuba igizwe n'amashusho yasikanywe.
history_empty: Nta ncamake zirabaho. Zizajya zigaragara hano uko uzikora.
history_clear_confirm: Ongera ukande kugira ngo usibe byose
error_no_transcript: Iyi videwo nta nyandiko y'ibivugwamo ifite yo gukorerwa incamake. YouTube iyigira gusa iyo videwo ifite insobanuro zanditse cyangwa insobanuro zikora ubwazo.
options_styles_help: Uburyo bwongera amabwiriza ku ncamake, urugero: Kora incamake yabyo nk'urukurikirane rw'ubutumwa butatu bugufi.
